finding.claim: The purge handler has no authorization check. checkPerm(u, "admin") is called but its boolean result is discarded, so any request that reaches purge runs purgeAll() regardless of the caller's permissions.
finding.source: Any HTTP request routed to purge. The caller needs only a request whose context carries a *User (any authenticated or low-privilege user). Route registration and middleware are not in this repo, so routing could not be confirmed.
finding.sink: purgeAll() at handlers.go:27 (protected destructive operation). purgeAll is a stub in this repo, so real impact depends on its production implementation.

trace.note: u := userFrom(r) takes the user from request context
checkPerm(u, "admin") evaluates the admin permission and discards the result

finding.guards_checked: checkPerm (handlers.go:12-14) returns a bool with no side effects, so calling it without using the result enforces nothing. mustPerm (handlers.go:16-22), the enforcing helper, is not called in purge; rotateKeys (lines 33-35) uses it correctly. userFrom (handlers.go:40) fails closed on a missing user (panic, so purge never reaches purgeAll), so it is not a bypass. No middleware or route-level check is visible in this repo.

verdict.guard_found: checkPerm (handlers.go:12-14) returns a bool with no side effects, and its result is discarded at handlers.go:26, so it enforces nothing. mustPerm (handlers.go:16-22) is the enforcing helper but is not called in purge (handlers.go:24-29). userFrom (handlers.go:40) panics on a missing user, which blocks anonymous requests but not any authenticated user. No middleware or route-level check is visible in this repo.
verdict.reason: The trace matches the code: purge at handlers.go:24-28 calls checkPerm(u, "admin") at line 26 and discards the bool, then runs purgeAll() at line 27, while rotateKeys at lines 33-35 correctly uses mustPerm. Any authenticated low-privilege user who reaches purge can trigger it, and nothing in this repo blocks that, though route registration and middleware are outside the repo and unverified.
